polity.canonical_name_en: Irish Confederacy of the Nine Years' War

activity.notes: Hugh O'Neill led the Gaelic Irish coalition in the Nine Years' War from its open-rebellion phase in 1594 until the negotiated submission at Mellifont in 1603. This label denotes a confederation of Irish lords and military-political authorities, not a retrojected unitary Irish nation-state.

sources.title: O'Neill, Hugh — Dictionary of Irish Biography
sources.citation_text: The Dictionary of Irish Biography records Hugh O'Neill's recognized lordship in Tyrone, his acquisition of the government of Tyrone in 1593, assumption of the title O'Neill in 1595, leadership of the confederate war, settlement in 1603, and flight in 1607.

sources.title: Nine Years' War — Wiley Blackwell Encyclopedia
sources.citation_text: The reference work describes the Nine Years' War as a rebellion led by Hugh O'Neill that became a major war involving a confederation of Irish lords and Spanish aid.
